The structural takeaway:
✅ Re-anchoring preserves direct ownership guarantees
✅ Scaling systems increasingly compete on custody assumptions
✅ Users want payment efficiency without surrendering control
✅ Trust minimization remains central to Bitcoin infrastructure design

That distinction is important because many scaling systems optimize convenience by introducing varying degrees of custodial dependency. ARK’s design instead tries to keep settlement assurances anchored to Bitcoin itself.
